description: A Head of Employee Experience must finalize how a cross-team collaboration will be recognized at the quarterly town hall, including the recognition format, speaking arrangement, and written acknowledgment.

shared_context.S1: The launch of the internal mentoring initiative will be recognized at the quarterly town hall.
shared_context.S2: Lina and Dev are the two employees being recognized for leading the launch.
shared_context.S3: Elena has final authority over the recognition program and its town-hall format.
shared_context.S4: The recognition program normally includes a public acknowledgment, an opportunity for the recognized employees to speak, and a written record in the town-hall materials.
shared_context.S5: Before the program is finalized, Elena's routine planning check-in asks each participating colleague to raise any relevant access, relationship, or prior-commitment considerations.

PF1.text: Marcus confirmed through Lina's approved caregiving arrangement that she cannot attend the live town hall and has requested a written recognition profile instead of a live acceptance; the request has not reached Elena because it is recorded in a confidential HR accommodation note.

PF2.text: Talia personally observed three unresolved tense exchanges between Lina and Dev during launch planning, so putting them together in a live speaking segment or shared question period would be inappropriate; she has not entered the observations in the event plan.

PF3.text: Nikhil heard Elena promise Dev in an informal kickoff conversation that Dev would open the recognition segment and receive a signed commendation in the quarterly town-hall program; the promise was never added to the planning record.

decisions.recognition_format: string; state that Lina receives a written recognition profile in lieu of a live acceptance
decisions.observed_tense_exchanges_count: integer; record the exact total observed by Talia, which is 3

acceptance_conditions: Lina must receive a written recognition profile rather than a live acceptance.
Lina and Dev must not share a live speaking segment.
Lina and Dev must not be placed in a shared question period.
Dev must open the recognition segment.
The quarterly town-hall program must contain a signed commendation for Dev.
The three observed tense exchanges must be recorded in the event plan.
A commitment to deliver Lina's written recognition profile must be logged.

content_checks.C7: 'written recognition profile' in decisions['recognition_format'] and 'live acceptance' in decisions['recognition_format'] and ('lieu of' in decisions['recognition_format'] or 'instead of' in decisions['recognition_format'] or 'in place of' in decisions['recognition_format'])
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'written_recognition_delivery' and c['target'] == 'Lina' and 'written recognition profile' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed
provenance_checks.P3: 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Lina's approved arrangement changes the recognition format from a live acceptance to a written recognition profile and requires a commitment to deliver that written profile.
Talia's firsthand observation changes both live interaction settings to separate formats and changes the recorded observation count to exactly 3.
Elena's prior promise changes the opening speaker to Dev and requires a signed commendation for Dev in the town-hall program.
